page.overview:
Who is Captain Norman Nash?

Captain Norman Nash was a British agent based in Yugoslavia. The character appeared in the 1963 James Bond film From Russia with Love and was portrayed by William Hill.

Nash was sent by M from station 'Y' to meet with James Bond in Zagreb. Shortly after the train arrived at the station, SPECTRE assassin Red Grant tricked the man into believing he was 007 and lured him into the station's restroom where he was killed. Grant then assumed the man's identity and introduced himself to Bond.
